name: skill-trending-monitor-cskill

metadata.description: Comprehensive skill ecosystem monitoring tool for Claude Code. Automatically tracks trending Claude Skills from skill-manager database (31,767 skills) and calculates week-over-week growth rates using GitHub API star history. Discovers new skills not locally installed with quality filters (stars >= 50, updated within 6 months). Identifies functionally similar alternatives using TF-IDF + cosine similarity algorithms (threshold 0.75). Recommends skill replacements with confidence scoring. Integrates security evaluation to filter risky skills (threshold 70). Generates weekly Markdown reports to meta/reports/ with trending analysis and replacement suggestions.

plugins.name: skill-trending-monitor-plugin
plugins.description: Comprehensive skill ecosystem monitoring tool for Claude Code. Automatically tracks trending Claude Skills from skill-manager database (31,767 skills) and calculates week-over-week growth rates using GitHub API star history. Discovers new skills not locally installed with quality filters (stars >= 50, updated within 6 months). Identifies functionally similar alternatives using TF-IDF + cosine similarity algorithms (threshold 0.75). Recommends skill replacements with confidence scoring (star ratio, recency factor, text similarity). Integrates security evaluation to filter risky skills (threshold 70). Generates weekly Markdown reports to meta/reports/ with sections: 🆕 New Skills, 🔥 Fastest Growing (5%+ WoW growth), 🔄 Replaceable Skills (confidence >= 0.70), 🛡️ Security Assessments, 📊 Statistics Summary. Perfect for maintaining optimal skill ecosystem with automated monitoring, security-first recommendations, and data-driven replacement suggestions using machine learning similarity detection and temporal growth analysis methodologies.

when_to_use: User explicitly asks about trending Claude Skills or skill popularity
User mentions skill recommendations, discovery, or finding new skills
User wants to compare installed skills with alternatives
User asks about skill growth rates, star counts, or ecosystem insights
User mentions security evaluation or checking if skills are safe
User wants weekly/periodic skill monitoring reports

when_not_to_use: User asks about specific skill usage documentation
User wants to create new skills (use agent-skill-creator)
User asks about skill installation commands
User wants to edit existing skill code
User asks about Claude Code config unrelated to skills
